caption: Columns 0 to 3 are the codes of M1 to M4; rows are the machines. The marked diagonal is each machine on its own code, and the bottom row D is the exact flip of those four answers, so D matches no row.

spec.title: D flips the diagonal
spec.aria: A table of yes/no halting answers for machines M1 to M4 on the four codes, with the main diagonal marked and a bottom row D holding the opposite of each marked diagonal entry.
